notes: cgroup max events report memory-limit pressure/reclaim, not OOM; process cache and concurrent research work affect these observations.
Capability-study NULL-default probes returned recovered query-level panic while canonical cases and health probes continued; no service crash inferred.
Main-run timings include reference/native checks and overlap with small capability probes and CH CLI/download work; not isolated performance.

scope: 50 time-series question templates times 200 unique configurations. 43 families use the 18-source dense-grid context; seven irregular event families use the entity/event/calendar context.

Fixed retrospective received-time snapshot; corrected historical readings can have arrived after their event day. Excluding current row in a baseline does not prove point-in-time training-feature availability.
Twenty prepended history days; longer frames near the first reported day can be partial. SQL default partial-frame semantics are deliberately checked.
Expected and actual full output arrays and SQL are retained. Numeric tolerance rtol=atol=1e-7; all declared discrete/time columns audited exactly after the run.
DuckDB materializes only deep-layer CTEs through optimizer hints; unchanged math independently checked with native NumPy.
No change to MO source/server binary; four CPU quota and 16GiB, one local instance; no distributed HA/long-term-production guarantee.

spark-summary.scope: Native Spark SQL on all 18 full-content audited JDBC sources; every result cell vs original-data DuckDB; actual Spark JDBC sink readback and cleanup. Supplemental case IDs overlap canonical IDs and are excluded from the 10000 main count.

performance.scope: SQL generation/query/fetch inside latency; connection creation outside latency but inside batch wall throughput. Gold verification after the whole timed batch. Warm local synthetic data, mixed query shapes, no other test clients, not server-only QPS.
